name: circles-ep01-tontine
script_changes: Scene 1 on-screen: '1653. Italy.' -> '1653. France.' Lorenzo de Tonti was Italian, but he proposed the tontine in France (to Cardinal Mazarin, 1653). The VO keeps 'an Italian banker'.

Scene 2 VO: 'Africa took the same word and built the opposite' -> 'in Africa, the same word came to mean the opposite'. Rotating circles in Africa are far older than the French word; the old line implied they were built after 1653.

voice.direction: Deep, warm documentary voice. Measured, unhurried pace, around 130 words per minute. Confident but never hypey. Think heritage documentary trailer, not a commercial. Minimal processing, natural room tone.
voice.pronunciation: tontine = ton-TEEN; Douala = doo-AH-lah; susu = SOO-soo; francs = frahn (soft, French)
voice.whisper_hint: Tontine. Douala, Cameroon. Susu. Francs. Circles of the World.

scenes.vo: In 1653, | an Italian banker invented the tontine. | Everyone paid in. | The last one alive took everything.

scenes.headline: Africa *rewrote* it.
scenes.vo: Three centuries later, | in Africa, the same word | came to mean the opposite: | a circle | where everyone gets their turn.

scenes.headline: *Everyone* pays in.
scenes.vo: It works like this. | Everyone pays in.

scenes.headline: One takes *the pot.*
scenes.vo: One person takes the whole pot.

scenes.headline: It goes *round.*
scenes.vo: Then it goes round, | until every member | has had a turn.

scenes.headline: Douala, *Cameroon.*
scenes.vo: In Douala, | a market woman puts in | ten thousand francs every Monday. | When her turn comes, | she stocks her entire stall. | No bank. | No paperwork. | Just trust.
scenes.delivery: warm, human, unhurried; this is the heart of the film

scenes.headline:
*The catch:*
someone holds the pot.
scenes.vo: One catch. | Someone has to hold the pot. | And when the circle | stretches across oceans, | trust has further to travel.
scenes.delivery: tension, slow down on the last line

scenes.headline: *Nobody* holds the pot.
scenes.vo: We kept the circle | and removed that one risk. | Same tontine, | one new rule: | nobody holds the pot. | It runs on rules | nobody can quietly break.
scenes.delivery: confident lift, peak conviction on "nobody holds the pot"

scenes.vo: Circles of the World. Next week: the susu. Link in bio to start your circle.
